title: Root-only secret with no key-name pattern: value-only redaction misses it when the value is unknown
reason_not_testable: The catalog lists unit, but the expected outcome is an unverified known leak for a value that is neither registered nor pattern-matched. The spec has no known-gap verdict, and a fixture asserting the leak would pass only by encoding a failure. Non-hook control: keep root-only plists free of secrets and rotate any value that appears in a tool result. Possible plist-key pattern rules are not testable as a pass.
